info.name: Pixl REST API
info.description:
Importable Postman collection for Pixl backend (backend/rest_server).

1. Set `baseUrl` (e.g. https://api.pixl-personal-project.online)
2. Call Auth → Login
3. Copy JWT from response into `jwt` variable
4. Protected routes use Bearer {{jwt}}

request.description: Copy returned JWT into collection variable `jwt`.
Fields are QUERY params, not JSON body.

item.name: 10. Admin & Moderator
item.description: Staff APIs. Login as admin@pixl.app / PixlAdmin!2026 (SUPER_ADMIN) or moderator@pixl.app / PixlMod!2026 (MODERATOR). Login saves `jwt`. Moderators cannot call staff/settings/flag endpoints.

request.description: Node authorizes; Java StreamService.forceEnd terminates media.
